name: Hazel
source:
The female protagonist. An ambitious, assertive perfectionist who has dedicated her entire life to her piano and pretty 2d characters (but we don't talk about that part). Her competitive nature might not always be so easy to deal with, but Hazel will go above and beyond for her few who do stick around. 

[From [url=https://teamfoxglove.itch.io/trouble-comes-twice]itch.io[/url]]
